hero.headline: A sacred home, shaped by community.
hero.lead: Durga Bari brings worship, cultural heritage, and community life together in one welcoming place.
hero.imageAlt: Worship at Durga Bari’s inaugural gathering

layout.headline: A living place for worship and connection.
layout.body: We envision a home for prayer and spiritual growth that also makes room for cultural programs, youth education, and community gatherings. The people who take part give Durga Bari its meaning.

layout.quote: A place to return to. A place to grow together.

layout.headline: The community is the beginning.
layout.body: Before any building, there are people who choose to gather, listen, and offer their time. These early moments are part of Durga Bari’s foundation.
layout.imageAlt: Durga Bari community members at a gathering

items.title: Devotion
items.body: A place to worship with humility and care.

items.title: Heritage
items.body: A place to practice and share our festivals, arts, and traditions.

items.title: Belonging
items.body: A place where generations and neighbors can come together.

layout.headline: There is room for you here.
layout.body: Join us in building a spiritual and cultural home for generations to come.
